question:
Re-read each record against its first-party page and establish the values its unknown classes name, at least the retention and per-object-cap notes, plus any interface, chaining, retention, per-object-cap or egress value listed for it.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- storage/gitlab-container-registry $.interface: Page names the registry endpoint only; nothing on oci or rclone as interfaces.
- storage/gitlab-com-git-lfs $.egress.metered: Page covers a request rate limit only. It says nothing about egress being metered or unmetered.
- storage/gitlab-container-registry $.egress.terms: Page names the endpoint only; no statement on egress charges or anonymous pulls/JWT.
- storage/gitlab-package-registry $.interface: REST API is documented; rclone appears nowhere on the page.
- storage/gitlab-package-registry $.chaining: No statement of unlimited projects, 200 projects per day, or separate accounting from repository limits on this page. The 5 GB figure is on the limits page, not this one.
- storage/gitlab-container-registry $.egress.metered: Page names the endpoint only; nothing on egress metering.
- storage/gitlab-package-registry $.retention.notes: Five-update history is stated; the page has no cleanup policy text, so "cleanup policy can delete package assets only if explicitly configured" is not on it.
- storage/gitlab-com-snippets $.chaining: No 300/hour creation limit, no "NOT enforced" storage statement; page says snippet repos count toward namespace storage.
- storage/gitlab-com-git-lfs $.free_tier.stated: 10 GiB, repository and LFS, and 500 GiB Premium/Ultimate are stated. Page lists only container registry, package registry and build artifacts as outside the limit; snippets, uploads and wikis are not stated as out, and the quoted phrase "Large File Storage (LFS)" is not verbatim.
- storage/gitlab-com-snippets $.limits_note: No 300 creations/hour or GraphQL createSnippet mention; page states a 50 MB default maximum snippet size, contradicting "no size cap found".
- storage/gitlab-com-git-lfs $.interface: LFS over HTTP is stated; "rest" is not named as an interface.
